verdict.rationale: Lambda's own docs describe filesystems as a "regional file store" and mention firewall rulesets scoped to instances "and their regions," so storage and instances are region-bound. The evidence never explicitly documents how a user picks a region for their data, which regions exist, or any data-residency guarantees. missing for 10: explicit documentation of choosing a region at filesystem/instance creation, a list of available regions/geographies, data-residency or compliance commitments, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: A filesystem is a high-capacity regional file store you can attach to your instance to store datasets and back up system state.
rulesets scoped to individual instances and their regions
